notes: Summary: Mid-market adtech platform evaluating inference for reranking & semantic features. High throughput (peak 10k qps internal), low 50-150ms p95 latency target on most user flows.
Primary motivators to self-host: strict data residency + kernel control to tune TensorRT for custom ops; finance prefers CapEx for infra vs. long-term SaaS OpEx.
Security friction: security team required air-gapped option and on-prem HSM. Redwood private offering didn't fully satisfy HSM + offline update workflow.

Champion: Growth eng manager (Kara Lim) was supportive but no exec sponsor to approve annual committed spend. Quote from Kara: 'We can't accept a vendor control plane for our logs — we need full custody.'
Pricing: initial Redwood estimate included dedicated pool and telemetry; customer projection of self-hosted TCO was 25-40% lower at scale after 12 months.
POC notes: ran a small proof on fashion-ranking dataset. Redwood latency numbers were competitive, but ops complexity and KMS/HSM integration flagged by security.
AE/SE takeaway: good technical fit, but procurement & security constraints + internal infra push led to closed-lost. Recommend light touch follow-up in 6 months for Optimize/Console offerings.
